full_judgment:
2. Short facts are that the property in question was originally allotted to one Md. Muslim who constructed a two storied building thereon taking loan from the House Building Finance Corporation, entered into an agreement for sale on 28.1.1971 for a consideration of Tk. 60,000/- upon receipt of Tk. 40,000/- as advance and it was stipulated that the kabala would be executed and registered within 6 months on receipt of balance consideration money, but the said vendor did not complete the same within 6 months. Later on his daughter informed that Md. Muslim died on 11.3.1972 and was buried at Mohammadpur Jame Mosque burial graveyard and agreeing to complete the sale, received Tk. 10,000/- on 9.5.1975 and Tk. 6,000/- on 19.2.1979. Ultimately the respondent No.3 having refused to execute the sale deed, the writ petitioner filed Title Suit No. 984 of 1980 for Specific Performance of Contract and for a declaration that the property was not abandoned property, which was decreed on 7.4.1981 and the sale deed was executed and registered through Court on 5.4.1983 in Executed Case No. 65 of 1981. A house survey on 26.4.1984 found the writ petitioner in actual possession. The writ petitioner having come to learn that the property has been in eluded in 'Ka' list as abandoned property filed Case No. 341 of 1947 in the Court of Settlement for release of the property from the list. Mobina Khatun daughter of Md. Muslim has also filed Case No. 382 of 1987 for release of the same. One Abdus Sattar also filed Case No. 843 of 1987 for release of the same on the plea that he took lease of the same from the Government. The writ respondent No.1 dismissed the case, against which the writ petitioner unsuccessfully moved the High Court Division in writ jurisdiction. 

 3. Leave was granted to consider the submission that Title Suit No. 984 of 1980 having been decreed on 7.4.1981 for Specific Performance of Contract and that the property is not abandoned property, the inclusion of the property in the list of abandoned puddings was without any lawful authority and the further submission that the case property being enlisted in the 'Ka' list and the writ petitioner being in possession of the property since 28.1.1971 on the strength of bainapntra and the subsequent decree dated 7.4.1981, the inclusion of the same in the "Ka" list was with-out lawful authority.
